definitions.gloss: artistic style; painting style; style of illustration
definitions.explanation: The distinctive visual style characteristic of a particular artist, school, or period. Used for painting, illustration, manga, and other visual art forms.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{画風|がふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This painter has a distinctive artistic style.

examples.japanese: {画風|がふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: People sometimes say that my artistic style has changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{漫画家|まんがか}→漫画家：08643_mangaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{画風|がふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変化|へんか}した→変化する：20997_henkasuru⟧。
examples.english: That manga artist's drawing style changed dramatically over the course of serialization.

notes:
Composed of {画|が} (picture, painting) + {風|ふう} (style, manner). The suffix {風|ふう} indicates a characteristic style or way of doing something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画風|がふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (one's artistic style changes)
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{画風|がふう} (distinctive artistic style)
- {画風|がふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確立|かくりつ}→確立：13758_kakuritsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (establish one's artistic style)
- ⟦{写実的|しゃじつてき}→写実的：17370_shajitsuteki⟧な{画風|がふう} (realistic painting style)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作風|さくふう}→作風：11460_sakufuu⟧ — creative style (broader, applies to writing, music, etc.)
- {画法|がほう} — painting technique (focuses on method rather than style)
- ⟦タッチ→タッチ：08915_tacchi⟧ — touch (loanword, used for the feel or quality of brushwork or line work)
